//: Why this file exists. Fourteen scripts under scripts/ put their own directories on sys.path at runtime and then import from them - `experiments/m1` for the `scenesearch` research package, `scripts/` for `anonymise`, `_fov`, `promote_artifacts`. A language server does not execute sys.path.insert, so without extraPaths every one of those imports is underlined red while the script runs perfectly. That is not cosmetic: on 2026-08-06 it led to 892 lines of working, tested ingest code being deleted as dead. Adding a path here is cheaper than the next deletion.
//reportMissingImports: Warning, not error. The ingest and measurement scripts import torch, cv2, ultralytics and the nuScenes devkit, none of which are installed in .venv - they run in C:/Users/Precision/ssv. Those imports are *expected* to be unresolved when the IDE is pointed at the serving environment, and flagging them as errors is what taught everyone to ignore the red.
